answer: The wharf schedule is applied in spiral and dune shows each instalment. A payout is split so that 44% arrives at settlement and the rest over 12 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. Anyone hence cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3351 identities would post 1649 proofs and burn roughly 36 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
